d_variant_a.stage: Stage 3 Variant A (CNN + LSTM → 1 mask via last hidden state)

d_seq.stage: Stage 3 Variant B (CNN + LSTM → mask per time step)

notes.stride_warning: stride=1 produces overlapping sequences sharing 9 of 10 CSI tensors. Use temporal block-based splitting (--write_splits) to prevent leakage.
notes.within_tensor_dynamics: The CNN encoder compresses 64 frames of intra-second dynamics into a single z. The LSTM operates only at the inter-tensor (~1 Hz) timescale.
